usedFor: Delighted holds survey feedback, and HubSpot receives a deal from “New Response” through “Create Deal” for follow-up.

bestTemplate.name: “New Response” in Delighted, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each survey answer opens a deal in HubSpot, so someone owns the follow-up.

watchOut: “New Response” fires for every response, not only low scores, so “Create Deal” also runs for happy customers.
